name: Victoria
description: Driscoll's blackberry variety -- large, sweet fruit, in commercial production in California since 2005 and grown in the UK (Kent) by Berry Gardens, a Driscoll's growing partner. Won HortWeek's Best New Variety (Top/Soft Fruit) award. Real, multi-source-confirmed commercial name; no plant-patent or PVR filing has been linked yet (added for the Variety Intelligence Backbone V1 mission's UK retail observation pilot, 2026-08-21, not from a registry filing).
